purpose: Targeted compact-layout T29 retest with the previous donor $TERGROUND method restored.
shared_rules: 74HC7266 in the prompt is normalized to the accepted Proteus donor family 74HC266.
Pin 14 and pin 7 supply instructions are accepted as user metadata but not emitted for IC packages.
R/C/L endpoints use $TERBIDIR, but passive G0 keeps the previous donor $TERGROUND method.
The V2 passive bidirectional G0 experiment is rejected for T29 based on user Proteus testing.
This pack emits only T29 because T30 already worked in the V2 pack.

cases.title: NOR Power-On Reset driving AND Enable
cases.description: V0 charges timing node through R/C; NOR output enables data through AND.
cases.hidden_supply_policy: Pin 14 and pin 7 are user-input-only metadata for 74HCxx gates; no explicit IC supply pins are emitted.
cases.terminal_policy: IC signal pins use $TERINPUT/$TEROUTPUT. R/C/L endpoints use $TERBIDIR. Passive G0 uses the previous donor $TERGROUND method.
cases.layout_policy: Compact T29 V3: IC package spacing is 3,810,000 and nearby passive columns start at x=8,890,000.
